keyPhrases.text: multi-layered, searing reminder of centuries-old animosities, exquisitely directed and produced
narrative is often compelling and there is a haunting sincerity to the characters

not for the fainthearted or those seeking a light evening of theater
some of what is presented here seems riddled in Irish clichés
might be a hard sell to American audiences
